newsitem.title: UK: Tanker of Russian crude aground off Germany - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Tanker of Russian crude aground off Germany - Lloyds.

text.p: A tanker carrying 85,000 tonnes of Russian crude oil ran aground in the Baltic Sea off the north coast of Germany at 2200 GMT on Sunday, Lloyds Shipping Intelligence said on Monday.

The Singapore-flagged 107,544 deadweight tonne North Pacific, which was carrying crude from the Latvian port of Ventspils to Dunkirk in France, grounded 8.5 nautical miles southeast of Gedser in the Mecklenburg Bay.
Lloyds said no oil had leaked from the vessel and the crew were still on board.
Three tugs were heading for the tanker to assist in a refloatation attempt early Monday afternoon, it said.
